KkdSession.label: koikatsucards.com Session Cookie
KkdSession.description:
Required to download cards from koikatsucards.com.

How to get it:
1. Log in to koikatsucards.com in your browser
2. Open DevTools (F12) → Application → Cookies → https://koikatsucards.com
3. Find the cookie named 'kkd_session' and copy its Value

⚠ This cookie expires every 7 days - re-copy it after it expires.

RenameCharaPrompt.name: prompt
RenameCharaPrompt.label: Rename Prompt
RenameCharaPrompt.description: Prompt sent to the LLM along with the character JSON. Edit to customise the instructions.
RenameCharaPrompt.default:
You will receive a JSON object whose keys identify Koikatsu character card files.
Each key has the format:  name | personality | hair_rgb

Your task: for every key fill in "lastname", "firstname", and "nickname" with the
character's well-known English name.

Rules:
- Use Western name order: firstname = given name, lastname = family name.
- Use the English name the character is commonly known by, not a literal
  transliteration (e.g. lastname "Tohsaka" firstname "Rin", not "Tosaka Rin").
- "nickname" can be a common short form or the same as firstname.
- All values must be valid Windows filenames
  (no  \\ / : * ? " < > |  characters, no leading/trailing spaces or dots).
- If you do not recognise the character or are not confident, leave all three
  fields as empty strings "".
- Return ONLY the completed JSON object - no explanation, no markdown fences,
  no extra text before or after.

JSON to fill in:

RenameCharaCopyStep1.label: Step 1 - Copy
RenameCharaCopyStep1.description: Scan the input folder, build the character key JSON and copy prompt + JSON to clipboard. Paste into your LLM.

RenameCharaCopyStep2.label: Step 2 - Paste
RenameCharaCopyStep2.description: After the LLM replies with the filled-in JSON, copy that response and click Paste to save it.

SkipAlreadyRenamed.label: Skip Already Renamed
SkipAlreadyRenamed.description: Skip cards whose filename already matches a known translated name in the cache

UpdateMetadata.label: Update Card Metadata
UpdateMetadata.description: Write the translated names into the card's internal metadata (lastname / firstname / nickname)

RenameFiles.label: Rename PNG Files
RenameFiles.description: Also rename the PNG file on disk to match the translated name (e.g. Tohsaka_Rin.png)

GroupCharaPrompt.name: prompt
GroupCharaPrompt.label: LLM Prompt
GroupCharaPrompt.description: Prompt template for the LLM (use {json} placeholder for the card JSON)
GroupCharaPrompt.placeholder: You will receive a JSON object whose keys identify Koikatsu character card files…
GroupCharaPrompt.default:
You will receive a JSON object whose keys identify Koikatsu character card files. Each key has the format:  name | personality | hair_rgb
Your task: for every key, write the name of the anime/game series the character is from as the value.
Rules:
- Values must be valid Windows folder names (no \ / : * ? " < > | characters).
- Use the official English title of the series.
- If a character appears in multiple series, use the one they are most associated with.
- If you are not sure or the character is an original creation, leave the value as an empty string "".
- Return ONLY the completed JSON object - no explanation, no markdown code fences, no extra text before or after.

JSON to fill in:

GroupCharaCopyStep1.label: Step 1 - Copy
GroupCharaCopyStep1.description: Scan the input folder, build character JSON and copy prompt + JSON to clipboard. Paste it into your LLM.

GroupCharaCopyStep2.label: Step 2 - Paste
GroupCharaCopyStep2.description: After the LLM replies with the filled-in JSON, copy that response and click Paste to save it.

GroupCharaIncludeSubfolders.label: Include subfolders
GroupCharaIncludeSubfolders.description: Also export character cards from subfolders. Disable to skip already-sorted cards.
